items.title: Ramstein Marks 25 Years Since 9/11 with 7th Annual Memorial March
items.description:
Before the first boots hit the pavement, every participant reached into a wooden crate and pulled out a lanyard.
Printed on each badge was a face, rank, and name of an emergency worker or first responder who ran toward danger on Sept. 11, 2001, and never returned. For the hundreds of service members, allied partners, and families gathered at Ramstein to mark the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks, the gesture made the morning’s mission personal: No one walked alone.

items.title: Volunteers Wanted: NMRC Clinical Trials Center Prepares for Phase 2 Trial of Respiratory Illness Treatment
items.description:
BETHESDA, Md. – Staff at Naval Medical Research Command (NMRC) are currently recruiting volunteers for a phase 2a study to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of INNA-051 a treatment for respiratory tract Illness.

INNA-051, a self-administered nasal spray, was previously determined by the NMRC Clinical Trials Center (CTC) to be safe for human use, and assessment which the FDA formally reviewed and confirmed in June.
